experience.seniorityNote: 2.7 years as of Sep 2026. APPLY to: 1-4 yr, 2-5 yr, 2-4 yr, SDE-2, Software Engineer II, mid-level. STRETCH (apply anyway if the JD is otherwise a strong match — Indian JDs routinely over-state the number): 3-6 yr. SKIP: 5+, 6+, 8+ minimum, Senior/Staff/Principal/Lead/Architect in the title, or any role requiring people management. For AI/agent roles specifically the field is young enough that '3-5 years' often means 'has actually shipped agents' — Dev qualifies on substance, so apply.

targetLanes.label: AI / Agentic Engineer
targetLanes.rationale: Dev's scarcest, highest-leverage asset. He has genuinely operated multi-agent systems (Claude Code skills, MCP servers, BMad, agent loops) in a production delivery pipeline — that is rare at any level and very rare at 2.7 years. Highest comp ceiling of the three lanes.

targetLanes.label: Forward Deployed Engineer
targetLanes.rationale: Direct hit: client-facing delivery with Norway/Germany/France teams, full-stack breadth, regulated-domain discipline, and agent tooling. FDE explicitly rewards the generalist-who-ships-with-the-customer profile.
targetLanes.judgeFromJdBody: Read the JD body before trusting the title. GOOD: builds software with/for customers, writes production code, integrations, deploys, technical depth expected. SKIP: pure pre-sales, quota-carrying, demo-only, account management, or a support/L2 role wearing an engineering title.

targetLanes.label: Mobile — Flutter / KMP / cross-platform
targetLanes.rationale: Deepest hands-on track record: 2.7 yrs shipping production Flutter and KMP/SwiftUI to the App Store and Play Store, including BLE/IoT and a DiGA/PECAN-certified app. Most reliable volume of interviews.

targetLanes.label: Full-stack — MERN only
targetLanes.rationale: React + Node + TypeScript are real and on the resume. Treated as the third lane: broadest volume, lowest differentiation, and one honest gap (MongoDB) — see resume-content.json doNotClaim.
targetLanes.constraint: MERN ONLY. Do NOT surface Java, .NET, PHP, Golang, Django-first, or Rails-first full-stack roles. Django and Rails stay on the resume as delivered facts, but they are not targets.

No ML/data-science background. Applied-AI product engineering only — not model training, MLOps, or data engineering.
Not a target: QA/automation-testing-only, L1/L2 support, or manual-testing roles.

scanning._locationRule: A posting is in scope when its LOCATION FIELD names an India city/country, or it is remote and its location names no foreign market. The JD body is deliberately NOT used for the India test: India-founded companies mention 'India' throughout their JDs, which let San Francisco and London roles through.
scanning._freshnessNote: Hard 21-day cutoff, from Ankur Kapuriya's runbook. Ranking is newest-first, match quality second: a 70% fit posted three hours ago beats a 90% fit posted six days ago, because on competitive roles the queue ahead of you matters more than the margin of fit. Override with --maxAgeDays / --rank quality.
scanning._marketplaceNote: Training/gig marketplaces that list their own sourcing roles rather than a real employer's. Ankur flags micro1 specifically as always out of scope regardless of how a listing is titled. Turing is kept as a Tier-A board for visibility, but a listing whose employer IS the marketplace is out of scope — only pursue ones naming a real end client.

delivery.digestNote: No heartbeat email. Silence means zero new matches — that is normal and expected.

guardrails.note: Discovery, matching, tailoring and reporting only. Every outward-facing action — application submit, profile signup, any email to a third party — is Dev's deliberate manual action, or is drafted, shown to him, and sent only on his explicit in-session go-ahead.

channels._note: Two channels run off the same scan. `india` is lane 1 (Dev's primary hunt). `remote-global` is the additive channel merged in from Ankur Kapuriya's runbook — non-Indian companies that will hire someone living in India.

india.description: Indian employers and India-located roles, on-site, hybrid or remote-within-India.

remote-global.description: Non-Indian companies hiring someone based in India — direct, contractor, or via an EOR (Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, Velocity Global).
remote-global.engagementNote: Contract and EOR work is NOT down-ranked. Ankur treats all three as equal and that is right — a USD contract role can pay multiples of an Indian full-time salary.
remote-global.compNote: USD 30k is roughly 25 LPA — about 2.8x Dev's current 8.94 and well above his stated 11-12 expectation. This channel is where the ceiling actually is. Verify India eligibility on the posting itself before investing time.

qualifies: Worldwide / anywhere / 'work from anywhere' with no country named
'Remote, India' or a named Indian city, or 'Remote, APAC' that includes India
Plain unqualified 'Remote' with no country lock stated
drops: 'Remote, US/USA/Canada/UK/EU/EMEA' or any single-country or bloc lock
LATAM-only, or any allowlist that excludes India
A named foreign city (on-site or hybrid)
eligibilityShapes.unconfirmed: When it cannot be confirmed either way, KEEP it and label it Unconfirmed. Never assume open, never assume closed.

remote-global._tagWarning: A board's own country tag is not evidence. Himalayas has repeatedly mistagged on-site EU/US roles as 'Worldwide'. Always verify against the actual posting.

founderOutreach._note: Secondary track from Ankur's runbook: a small, deliberately slow channel that goes around job boards entirely. Research and drafts ONLY — nothing is ever sent by the system.

companyFilter._excludeNote: Ankur excludes Indian-HQ startups because he wants non-Indian remote work. Dev does NOT exclude them — a funded Indian startup is a perfectly good target for his lane 1.

rules.linkedin: Never fabricated. A founder with no verifiable profile gets the row flagged and left blank.
rules.email: A clearly-labelled GUESSED first@domain pattern only. It is never treated as verified. Dev verifies it himself (e.g. Hunter.io) before sending.
rules.drafts: One email and one LinkedIn message per company, each carrying a visible note to add one genuine personal observation before sending.
rules.sending: NEVER. The system finds and drafts; Dev reviews and sends everything himself.

founderOutreach.dedupeRule: Founder companies are deduped on COMPANY NAME ALONE — a second role at a company already approached is still the same relationship.
